newsitem.title: USA: RMH Teleservices sets IPO price terms.
newsitem.headline: RMH Teleservices sets IPO price terms.

text.p: RMH Teleservices Inc set estimated pricing terms for its planned initial public offering at between $11.50 and $13.50 a share in a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.

RMH, which provides outbound teleservices for insurance and financial services companies, would sell a roughly 26 percent stake in the company to the public in the 2.8 million share offering, according to an August 20 filing.
RMH, based in Bryn Mawr, Pa., posted operating income of $2.0 million of revenues of $25.5 million in fiscal 1995.
